Nothing gets printed until somebody orders it.

The industry standard is to guess. Print thousands of a design, warehouse them, and after a few months, get rid of whatever never sold. An enormous amount of clothing is made, shipped, and thrown out without ever being worn once.

Here, blank shirts are kept on hand. What we don't do is print a design onto one until an order comes in.

When a design does not sell, nothing was wasted except our opinion of it.
